description: See your GitHub merge queues in the sidebar and get alerted when your PR merges or gets kicked out.
viewContainer.title: Merge Queues
view.queues.name: Merge Queues
welcome.noRepos:
Track a GitHub merge queue to see its pull requests here and get alerted when yours merge or get removed.
[Add repository](command:mqTracker.addRepo)
[Learn about merge queues](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/collaborating-with-pull-requests/incorporating-changes-from-a-pull-request/merging-a-pull-request-with-a-merge-queue)
welcome.signIn:
Sign in to GitHub to see the merge queues you track.
[Sign in to GitHub](command:mqTracker.signIn)
config.repos: Repositories whose merge queues to track, as `{ "repo": "owner/name", "branch": "main" }`. Leave `branch` out to use the repository's default branch. At most 20.
config.repos.branch: Branch whose merge queue to watch. Defaults to the repository's default branch.
config.pollSeconds: Seconds between polls while the window is focused. Minimum 15.
config.notify: Show a notification when one of your pull requests merges or is removed from a queue.
config.enterpriseUri: GitHub Enterprise Server URL, for example `https://github.example.com`. Leave empty for github.com. When empty, VS Code's own `#github-enterprise.uri#` is used if set; that setting is needed for sign-in either way.
welcome.workspaceRepo:
This workspace's git remote points at a GitHub repository.
[Track this workspace's repository](command:mqTracker.addWorkspaceRepo)
config.unfocusedPollSeconds: Seconds between polls while the VS Code window is not focused, so merge and removal alerts still arrive while you work elsewhere. Never faster than `#mqTracker.pollSeconds#`. Set to 0 to pause polling until the window is focused again.
config.notifyProgress: Also notify when one of your queued pull requests becomes next to merge or stops being mergeable. Has no effect when `#mqTracker.notify#` is off.
walkthrough.title: Get started with Merge Queue Tracker
walkthrough.description: See your GitHub merge queues in the sidebar and get alerted when your pull request merges or gets kicked out.
walkthrough.signIn.title: Sign in to GitHub
walkthrough.signIn.description:
The extension reuses VS Code's GitHub sign-in. No token to paste.
[Sign in](command:mqTracker.signIn)
walkthrough.addRepo.title: Track a repository
walkthrough.addRepo.description:
Pick from the repositories you can access, type owner/name, or track the one open in this workspace.
[Add repository](command:mqTracker.addRepo)
[Track this workspace's repository](command:mqTracker.addWorkspaceRepo)
walkthrough.alerts.title: Tune the alerts
walkthrough.alerts.description:
Polling slows down while the window is unfocused instead of stopping, so alerts still arrive. Adjust that, or mute notifications, in settings.
[Open settings](command:mqTracker.openSettings)
walkthrough.demo.title: Try it without a queue
walkthrough.demo.description:
Demo mode plays a scripted queue with no sign-in and no network: a pull request enters, moves up, merges, and another gets removed.
[Toggle demo mode](command:mqTracker.toggleDemo)
